root_cause.text: The UDP receive function skb_consume_udp() calls skb_attempt_defer_free() on an skb that may have its destructor set by the skmsg layer (via skb_set_owner_sk_safe() in udp_read_skb()), violating skb_attempt_defer_free()’s assumption that skb->destructor is NULL and triggering the warning DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE(skb->destructor).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_orphan(skb);` before `skb_attempt_defer_free(skb);` in `skb_consume_udp()` (net/ipv4/udp.c). The commit message explicitly states: "Standard UDP receive path does not use skb->destructor. But skmsg layer does use it, since it calls skb_set_owner_sk_safe() from udp_read_skb(). This then triggers this warning in skb_attempt_defer_free(): DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE(skb->destructor)."
